## Description {#details}

<p>A smart pointer to a reference-counted object that inherits from <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/refcountedbase">RefCountedBase</a> or <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/threadsaferefcountedbase">ThreadSafeRefCountedBase</a>.</p>


<p>This class increments its pointee's reference count when it is created, and decrements its refcount when it's destroyed (or is changed to point to a different object).</p>


<p>Definition at line 173 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/intrusiverefcntptr-h">IntrusiveRefCntPtr.h</a>.</p>
